items.brief: OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue launches with 113 assets for 24/7 trading
items.why: Shows a major venue listing 113 tokenized securities for round-the-clock trading.

items.brief: OKX and ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
items.why: Highlights 113 tokenized assets going live amid pushback from 67 companies.

items.brief: Fidelity, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
items.why: Named issuers join a venue confirming 113 tokenized assets for listing.

items.brief: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
items.why: Banks could use tokenized securities as collateral under the DLT pilot program.

items.brief: South Korea to publish draft crypto legal framework this week
items.why: Draft includes licensing and a bank-centered stablecoin issuance system.

items.brief: OCBC, StraitsX pilot cross-border stablecoin payments for businesses
items.why: Uses onchain collection and compliance with an OCBC fiat off-ramp.

items.brief: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits and securities experiments
items.why: Central bank explores tokenized deposits and securities under its Appia initiative.
